title: AC1024 generated SingleEdge geometry-dependency graph output

scope.source: Locally authored in-memory dx_data graph in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp; no external DWG/DXF fixture file.
scope.graph: NOD -> DICTIONARY -> root ACDBASSOCNETWORK -> one ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP -> one AcConstrainedImplicitPoint -> ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY -> LINE.

dependency.reactorBacklink: exactly one backlink from the target LINE

implementation.summary: Admitted a bounded AC1024 root-network / constraint-group / SingleEdge geometry-dependency graph through source identity reservation, owned-edge and inline-node closure, target entity/reactor closure, handle remapping, and staged document output. Added DXF parsing for the emitted constraint-group wrapper and the dependency base/geometry subclass fields. Geometry dependency wire completeness requires the complete base and geometry prefixes plus bounded body/string/handle alignment.
implementation.transaction: In ASCII and binary modes, an unresolved group action target is refused while preserving the destination sentinel; correcting the action target and retrying on the same adapter succeeds.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Graph authored in test code. Output files use temporary paths and are removed by the selector; no DWG/DXF fixture files were added.

proof.emittedRecords: Counts exactly one ACDBASSOCNETWORK, ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP and ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY record in each output encoding.
proof.readback: Fresh fileImport confirms one LINE; network-to-group owned action and parent; group-to-dependency action and implicit-point node reference; dependency owner, complete geometry subclass fields and target handle; and exactly one target reactor backlink.
proof.failureRetry: The selector corrupts the group action handle, verifies complete-export refusal and preservation of a preexisting destination sentinel, restores the handle, and verifies successful retry on the same adapter for ASCII and binary DXF.

limits: This is a generated AC1024 graph proof for the selected SingleEdge geometry-dependency profile, not a physical-source associative conversion proof.
The output check counts object records and uses fresh libdxfrw readback; it is not an independent raw group-pair wire oracle or native CAD semantic acceptance.
Physical mechanical associative callback coverage, all other group node/dependency profiles, recursive descendants outside this graph, and strict complete physical-source export remain open.
This does not establish LibreCAD/FreeCAD consumer behavior, 3D support, or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
remainingP4Scope: Bind the physical mechanical source's callback identities to required output fields and roles, add missing required providers and descendants, prove exact emitted output independently, and pass strict complete-export admission without weakening refusal.
nextAction: Use the AC1024 opaque-callback census and existing source-profile receipts to select the highest-incidence required physical-source profile with an unproven output provider.
